name: Emotional Damage
description: Hand on your chest: crash zoom, shaking camera, red flash and EMOTIONAL DAMAGE.
origin: Steven He’s “EMOTIONAL DAMAGE!” from his Asian-parent sketches.
whatHappens: Your video crash-zooms onto your face with a shaky handheld camera and a red flash, EMOTIONAL DAMAGE slams onto the screen, and everyone hears the shout.
how: Press one flat hand on your chest, like you just took a hit, and hold it still for a moment.
tips: One hand only: both hands at your chest is the broccoli plate.
Keep the hand below your chin, in the middle of your chest.
